title: Octocode Scraping Vendor Provider Contract
description: Any scraping vendor plugs in by implementing FetchResponse and registering a ProviderDescriptor in scripts/lib/providers.mjs. Corpus building and extraction (scripts/lib/corpus.mjs, analyzers.mjs, extractors.mjs) only ever consume FetchResponse — they do not know which vendor produced it.

FetchResponse.description: Return shape every provider.fetch({ url, pageId, config, apiKey }) must produce.

body.description: Raw response text; may be JSON-in-a-string (vendor envelope) or raw HTML/markdown.

creditCost.description: Vendor-reported per-request cost, or null when the vendor has no cost concept (e.g. a keyless direct fetch).

ProviderDescriptor.description: Registry entry shape in the PROVIDERS map in scripts/lib/providers.mjs.

fetch.description: async ({ url, pageId, config, apiKey }) => FetchResponse

apiKeyEnv.description: Env var name to read the key from; null when requiresApiKey is false.

cleanup.description: optional async (config) => void, called once after the fetch/crawl loop completes — for providers that hold a persistent resource (e.g. a launched browser)
